title: Snoop Dogg Rips Lakers' Anthony Davis Apart On IG DJ Whookid's IG Story
htmlContent:
Snoop Dogg is an avid fan of Los Angeles sports, especially the Los Angeles Lakers.

The Lakers have been his team since the dawn of time. So there's no question he's had a lot to cheer about since LeBron James joined the team in 2018. In 2020, this team went on to win a championship, and while the team was unable to repeat this success, Snoop remained committed.

Unfortunately, some Lakers players have suffered constant injuries. One of those players is Anthony Davis, and as it turns out, Snoop was absolutely critical of the star. On many occasions, Snoop called Anthony Davis "soft," and now it looks like Davis tired of the verbal abuse.

Snoop talked about AD during a recent studio session when he disclosed that the Lakers star had unfollowed on Instagram. But, of course, Snoop couldn't care less about the Lakers superstar, and if he saw him in person, he wouldn't even talk to him.

"I ain't got nothing to say to that n***. That n*** unfollowed me on Instagram. When I said something about him," Snoop said.

"Called him a H** a** n*** you are too big to be playing that little. My s*** said ding thing."

The Los Angeles Lakers play the Milwaukee Bucks at home on Monday evening at 10 pm EST. Hopefully, Davis and the Lakers can continue their one-game win streak to help them improve in the Western Conference standings. They are currently in ninth place. Also, Snoop and Davis can get back in each other good graces at some point.
